description: This file defines the FieldMigration class, a Drupal migration plugin for handling field configuration and values during data migration processes.

classes.name: FieldMigration
classes.description: A Drupal migration plugin class for migrating field configurations and values, extending the Migration class and implementing ContainerFactoryPluginInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FieldMigration with various plugin managers and the field discovery service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies retrieved from the container.

methods.name: getProcess
methods.description: Overrides parent method to add all field processes via the field discovery service on first call.
